items_flat.title_en: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 for demanding technical work
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 發布 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Mythos 5.2，針對高難度技術工作
items_flat.summary_en: On November 9, Anthropic introduced Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 as the same underlying model, with stronger safeguards on Fable. The models improve coding, reasoning, and vision while generating outputs up to 30% faster than the 5.1 versions; Fable is generally available at reduced pricing while Mythos remains limited to vetted organizations.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月9日，Anthropic 推出 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Claude Mythos 5.2，兩者為同一底層模型，Fable 具備更強安全防護。模型在編碼、推理與視覺上提升，輸出速度較 5.1 版本快最多 30%；Fable 一般可用且定價下調，Mythos 則限於審核通過的組織。
items_flat.analysis_en: The dual-release structure lets Anthropic ship high capability while gating the highest-risk domains. Benchmark gains on agentic coding and science tasks are large relative to 5.1, but real-world reliability outside controlled settings still needs independent confirmation.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 雙版本結構讓 Anthropic 在釋出高能力的同時限制高風險領域。相較 5.1 在代理編碼與科學任務上的基準提升明顯，但在受控環境外的實際可靠性仍需獨立驗證。
items_flat.quote: Our most capable models for daunting technical work, Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 set a new bar in coding, finance, and the sciences.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們針對艱鉅技術工作的最強模型 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Claude Mythos 5.2，在編碼、金融與科學領域設立了新標竿。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT Wallet for secure agent payments
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Wallet，讓代理安全完成付款
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Wallet on November 13, enabling AI agents (dots) to complete purchases without accessing users’ actual card details. Every transaction requires user approval with a security check such as biometrics; initial rollout is limited to eligible U.S. ChatGPT Pro subscribers aged 18+ with U.S.-issued cards from Amex, Mastercard, or Visa.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 於11月13日宣布 ChatGPT Wallet，讓 AI 代理（dots）在不接觸用戶實際卡號的情況下完成購買。每筆交易都需用戶以生物辨識等安全檢查批准；初期僅限符合資格的美國 18 歲以上 ChatGPT Pro 訂閱者，並使用美國發行的 Amex、Mastercard 或 Visa 卡。
items_flat.analysis_en: This moves agentic commerce from research demos into a controlled production path that preserves existing card rails and user control. Success still depends on merchant and risk-system adoption to avoid false declines.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這將代理商務從研究展示推進到受控的生產路徑，保留現有卡軌與用戶控制。成功仍取決於商家與風險系統的採用，以避免誤拒交易。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing ChatGPT Wallet, setting a new bar for secure payments by agents. It’s the first wallet that lets agents pay without access to users’ actual card details and that requires a security check for every purchase.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出 ChatGPT Wallet，為代理安全付款設立新標竿。這是首個讓代理在不接觸用戶實際卡號的情況下付款，且每筆購買都需安全檢查的錢包。

items_flat.title_en: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen for faster everyday agentic workflows
items_flat.title_zh: Google 推出 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，加速日常代理工作流程
items_flat.summary_en: On November 12, Google DeepMind and Google introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen, positioned as a fast, efficient model for coding and agentic workflows rather than the deepest long-horizon reasoning of Carbon or Argon. It is available across the Gemini API, app, Search, and paid tiers at $1.50 / $7.50 per million tokens, claiming speed and intelligence gains over Gemini 3.8 Flash.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月12日，Google DeepMind 與 Google 推出 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，定位為針對編碼與代理工作流程的快速高效模型，而非 Carbon 或 Argon 的深度長程推理。可在 Gemini API、應用、搜尋與付費層級使用，定價每百萬 token $1.50 / $7.50，宣稱較 Gemini 3.8 Flash 在速度與智能上提升。
items_flat.analysis_en: Hydrogen broadens Gemini 4 access at a lower price point while claiming speed and efficiency gains over 3.8 Flash. It does not displace the higher-capability Carbon/Argon tier, so the practical division of labor across the family will depend on real workload results.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Hydrogen 以較低價格擴大 Gemini 4 的可用範圍，並宣稱較 3.8 Flash 在速度與效率上提升。它並未取代更高能力的 Carbon/Argon 層級，家族內的實際分工仍取決於真實工作負載結果。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen, bringing cutting-edge intelligence to everyone — with speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agentic workflows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，將前沿智能帶給所有人——以速度與效率支援日常編碼與代理工作流程。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini Robotics 2.5 for improved real-world dexterity
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 Gemini Robotics 2.5，提升真實世界靈巧度
items_flat.summary_en: On November 10, Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2.5, a vision-language-action model that expands task breadth and learning speed. In a Mercedes-Benz proof-of-concept, Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid achieved a reported 96% success rate on a parts-packing workflow, with broader evaluations showing 30–100% higher success rates than prior baselines on many tasks.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月10日，Google DeepMind 發布 Gemini Robotics 2.5，這是一個擴展任務廣度與學習速度的視覺-語言-動作模型。在 Mercedes-Benz 概念驗證中，Apptronik 的 Apollo 2 人形機器人在零件包裝工作流程上達到報導的 96% 成功率，更廣泛評估顯示許多任務的成功率較先前基線提升 30–100%。
items_flat.analysis_en: The industrial pilot supplies a concrete reliability signal beyond lab benchmarks, yet the 96% figure is vendor-reported on a narrow workflow. Broader generalization and safety in unstructured environments remain open questions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 工業試點提供了超越實驗室基準的具體可靠性訊號，但 96% 數字為供應商在狹窄工作流程上的報告。在非結構化環境中的更廣泛泛化與安全性仍是開放問題。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are introducing Gemini Robotics 2.5, our most capable vision-language-action (VLA) model to date.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出 Gemini Robotics 2.5，這是我們迄今最強的視覺-語言-動作（VLA）模型。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches roadshow for proposed IPO
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 啟動擬議 IPO 路演
items_flat.summary_en: On November 10, Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of Class A common stock. The company had previously filed a Form S-1 with the SEC; the offering contemplates roughly 825 million shares at an expected $70–$78 range for a Nasdaq listing under the ticker ANT.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月10日，Anthropic, PBC 啟動其擬議 A 類普通股首次公開發行的路演。公司此前已向 SEC 提交 Form S-1；發行預計約 8.25 億股，預期價格區間 $70–$78，計劃在 Nasdaq 以 ANT 代號上市。
items_flat.analysis_en: The roadshow advances Anthropic’s transition from private lab to public company while it continues to ship frontier models. Market reception and any conditions attached to the offering will shape its capital structure going forward.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 路演推進 Anthropic 從私人實驗室轉向上市公司，同時持續發布前沿模型。市場反應與發行附加條件將影響其未來資本結構。
items_flat.quote: Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，Anthropic, PBC 啟動其擬議 A 類普通股首次公開發行的路演。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI reorganizes stand-alone robotics team into core research and Applied
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 將獨立機器人團隊重組至核心研究與 Applied
items_flat.summary_en: On November 13, OpenAI confirmed to Fortune that it has reorganized its stand-alone robotics team. Research staff now report to Chief Research Officer Mark Chen; applied robotics and hardware teams moved under President Greg Brockman’s Applied organization. The company framed the change as accelerating progress via general models such as GPT-6 Astra rather than a retreat.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月13日，OpenAI 向 Fortune 確認已重組其獨立機器人團隊。研究人員現向首席研究官 Mark Chen 報告；應用機器人與硬體團隊則移至總裁 Greg Brockman 的 Applied 組織。公司將此舉定位為透過 GPT-6 Astra 等通用模型加速進展，而非撤退。
items_flat.analysis_en: The move signals a strategic bet that frontier general models can reduce the need for specialized robotics teams, echoing OpenAI’s 2020 pause and 2024 restart. It is not framed as an abandonment, but the absence of a dedicated team raises questions about near-term hardware integration pace.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉顯示戰略押注：前沿通用模型可降低對專門機器人團隊的需求，呼應 OpenAI 2020 年暫停與 2024 年重啟。並未定位為放棄，但缺乏專門團隊引發對短期硬體整合進度的疑問。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind releases PARDIG and SatWeave weather datasets
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 發布 PARDIG 與 SatWeave 天氣資料集
items_flat.summary_en: On November 13, Google DeepMind released two foundational datasets used by WeatherNext 3: SatWeave (a global mosaic of geostationary satellite imagery) and PARDIG (an AI-based global precipitation dataset). Historical archives and live feeds are available on Google Cloud Storage (and Earth Engine for PARDIG), with claimed gains in precipitation detection skill.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月13日，Google DeepMind 發布 WeatherNext 3 所使用的兩大基礎資料集：SatWeave（全球靜止衛星影像拼接）與 PARDIG（基於 AI 的全球降水資料集）。歷史存檔與即時資料流可在 Google Cloud Storage（PARDIG 亦可在 Earth Engine）取得，並宣稱降水偵測技巧有所提升。
items_flat.analysis_en: Open observational datasets lower the barrier for third parties to build on DeepMind’s weather stack. Independent validation of the claimed precipitation-skill gains will determine how widely they are adopted beyond the lab’s own models.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 開放觀測資料集降低第三方在 DeepMind 天氣堆疊上建構的門檻。對所宣稱降水技巧提升的獨立驗證，將決定它們在實驗室自身模型之外被廣泛採用的程度。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are releasing two foundational datasets, SatWeave and PARDIG, to support the global community in building weather, hydrology, and climate applications.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們發布兩個基礎資料集 SatWeave 與 PARDIG，以支援全球社群建構天氣、水文與氣候應用。

items_flat.title_en: Meta introduces Muse Ember, a small efficient model for agentic workloads
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 推出 Muse Ember，針對代理工作負載的小型高效模型
items_flat.summary_en: On November 9, Meta AI announced Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient model to date, built for high-volume agentic tasks such as tool calls, coding subtasks, and long-document parsing. It is available on the Meta Model API at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens, with native multimodal support and a 1M-token context window.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月9日，Meta AI 宣布 Muse Ember，這是其迄今最小且最高效的模型，針對高量代理任務如工具呼叫、編碼子任務與長文件解析。可在 Meta Model API 以每百萬輸入 token $0.10、輸出 $0.50 取得，具備原生多模態支援與 100 萬 token 上下文視窗。
items_flat.analysis_en: Ember extends Meta’s Muse family into a low-cost, high-throughput tier, aiming at the economics of always-on agents. Claims of matching or beating Haiku 5.5 at one-third the cost need independent verification on sustained real workloads.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Ember 將 Meta 的 Muse 家族延伸至低成本、高吞吐量層級，瞄準持續運行代理的經濟性。關於以三分之一成本匹配或超越 Haiku 5.5 的宣稱，需在持續真實工作負載上獨立驗證。
items_flat.quote: Today we're introducing Muse Ember, our smallest and most efficient model, built for complex reasoning execution and everyday agent work.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Muse Ember，這是我們最小且最高效的模型，針對複雜推理執行與日常代理工作而打造。

google.summary_zh: 11月13日，Google DeepMind 發布 WeatherNext 3 所使用的兩大基礎資料集：SatWeave（全球靜止衛星影像拼接）與 PARDIG（基於 AI 的全球降水資料集）。歷史存檔與即時資料流可在 Google Cloud Storage（PARDIG 亦可在 Earth Engine）取得，並宣稱降水偵測技巧有所提升。
google.analysis_en: Open observational datasets lower the barrier for third parties to build on DeepMind’s weather stack. Independent validation of the claimed precipitation-skill gains will determine how widely they are adopted beyond the lab’s own models.
google.analysis_zh: 開放觀測資料集降低第三方在 DeepMind 天氣堆疊上建構的門檻。對所宣稱降水技巧提升的獨立驗證，將決定它們在實驗室自身模型之外被廣泛採用的程度。
google.quote: Today, we are releasing two foundational datasets, SatWeave and PARDIG, to support the global community in building weather, hydrology, and climate applications.
google.quote_zh: 今天，我們發布兩個基礎資料集 SatWeave 與 PARDIG，以支援全球社群建構天氣、水文與氣候應用。

meta.title_en: Meta introduces Muse Ember, a small efficient model for agentic workloads
meta.title_zh: Meta 推出 Muse Ember，針對代理工作負載的小型高效模型
meta.summary_en: On November 9, Meta AI announced Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient model to date, built for high-volume agentic tasks such as tool calls, coding subtasks, and long-document parsing. It is available on the Meta Model API at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens, with native multimodal support and a 1M-token context window.
meta.summary_zh: 11月9日，Meta AI 宣布 Muse Ember，這是其迄今最小且最高效的模型，針對高量代理任務如工具呼叫、編碼子任務與長文件解析。可在 Meta Model API 以每百萬輸入 token $0.10、輸出 $0.50 取得，具備原生多模態支援與 100 萬 token 上下文視窗。
meta.analysis_en: Ember extends Meta’s Muse family into a low-cost, high-throughput tier, aiming at the economics of always-on agents. Claims of matching or beating Haiku 5.5 at one-third the cost need independent verification on sustained real workloads.
meta.analysis_zh: Ember 將 Meta 的 Muse 家族延伸至低成本、高吞吐量層級，瞄準持續運行代理的經濟性。關於以三分之一成本匹配或超越 Haiku 5.5 的宣稱，需在持續真實工作負載上獨立驗證。
meta.quote: Today we're introducing Muse Ember, our smallest and most efficient model, built for complex reasoning execution and everyday agent work.
meta.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Muse Ember，這是我們最小且最高效的模型，針對複雜推理執行與日常代理工作而打造。

brief_en: No major new lab announcements in the last 12 hours. Today's picture remains Anthropic's Fable/Mythos 5.2 and IPO roadshow, OpenAI's ChatGPT Wallet and robotics reorg, Google's Gemini 4 Hydrogen plus Robotics 2.5 and weather datasets, and Meta's Muse Ember.
brief_zh: 過去12小時無重大新公告。今日重點仍為Anthropic的Fable/Mythos 5.2與IPO路演、OpenAI的ChatGPT Wallet與機器人團隊重組、Google的Gemini 4 Hydrogen及Robotics 2.5與天氣資料集，以及Meta的Muse Ember。
